items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: Let them in. The food's nearly ready.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I told Grandma on Friday. I awakened this week.

items.speaker: SIBLING
items.text: You said we'd do the sky together.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: A gate opened at the shop on Tuesday. We all got outside. The hunters cleared it.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I saw a message saying I was a summoner.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I kept thinking I'd call when I knew what to say.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: I did. My output's low. We found a little connection. We still don't know how to send him back.

items.speaker: GRANDMOTHER
items.text: Is there someone you need to tell where you are?

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: I can't tell anyone. I don't know how to reach them.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Yes. I worked yesterday so I could come today.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: You left all the same-looking ones.

items.speaker: SIBLING
items.text: Here. It gets wider on this side.

items.speaker: NIB
items.text: You've got the whole picture there.

items.speaker: SIBLING
items.text: That's what he said last time.

items.speaker: TAEO
items.text: Show me which side gets wider.
